seeds.vh-4-2-0-0: Frost coats your eyelashes on the shattered ice shelf as you drag the humming bronze clapper past a yawning blue crevasse.
seeds.vh-4-2-0-1: Biscuit digs her iron hooves into the sliding firn while the gale tries to strip the heavy woollen cradle from your frozen back.
seeds.vh-4-2-1-0: You shelter beneath an overhanging serac where a shivering ropewright named Orry splices a frayed guyline with numbed fingers.
seeds.vh-4-2-1-1: A sudden avalanche of powdery snow sweeps across the lower ladder, burying your traction spikes just as daylight fails completely.
seeds.vh-4-2-1-2: You negotiate a slick ice-bridge over a bottomless abyss while the bronze clapper hums a warning note against your spine.
seeds.vh-4-2-1-3: An old cable-lord named Kimmich blocks the narrow cornice, demanding an exorbitant toll for the maintenance of the swaying hemp handrails.
seeds.vh-4-2-1-4: Unencumbered by the mule, you squeeze through a tight blue ice-tunnel that bypasses the treacherous gale-swept ridge entirely.
seeds.vh-4-2-1-5: You chip frozen rungs into a vertical blue wall of ice while the wind screams like a trapped mountain hawk overhead.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-0: A terrace miller named Joram offers you a cup of scorched barley tea behind a wind-break of stacked blue ice blocks.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-1: The hemp bridge shudders violently under a gust, threatening to pitch both you and the bronze clapper into the white void below.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-2: You crawl across a narrow ribbon of blue ice on your belly while loose crystals roar down the couloir beside you.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-3: A fog-warden named Tilda signals with a bronze hand-bell through the swirling drift, guiding you away from a hidden crevasse.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-4: Biscuit refuses to cross the icy threshold of an old avalanche chute until you blindfold her with a frozen scarf.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-5: You mend a snapped guide-rope using an old ropewright knot while freezing spray pelts your raw and bleeding knuckles.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-6: A jagged pillar of blue glacier-glass groans ominously above your head as you haul the heavy bronze load upward.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-7: Recognizing your sworn knot-oath, the ropewright guards lower a sheltered ice-chute shortcut straight down the glacier's frozen spine.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-8: You slide down a steep firn chute on your heels, balancing the humming metal weight against the rushing mountain wind.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-9: A frozen waterfall blocks the ladder steps, forcing you to hack fresh footholds with a blunt iron utility axe.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-10: You share a hard biscuit and a handful of dried plums with a stranded cable-inspector named Hauer in a shallow snow cave.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-11: The glacier shifts with a sound like rolling thunder, opening a fresh fissure inches from your trembling lead boots.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-12: You haul the mule across a slick bridge of packed avalanche snow while fine rime freezes over your heavy woolen mittens.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-13: An abandoned supply sledge lies half-buried in blue ice, its runners twisted like dry twigs by the relentless pressure.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-14: You navigate a maze of towering seracs while the sun casts an eerie green glow through the ancient ice.
seeds.vh-4-2-2-15: A gust of wind tears your woolen cap into the abyss as you wrestle the heavy clapper along the narrow ledge.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-0: You cross a swinging rope bridge where each frozen plank is coated in a thin sheet of treacherous black rime.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-1: A terrace miller named Vane shouts warnings from an upper outcrop about shifting snow bridges across the deep glacial moat.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-2: You wedge yourself into a narrow cleft in the ice wall to shelter from a sudden blinding squall of stinging hail.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-3: Biscuit slips on a patch of blue glare-ice, nearly dragging you backward into the dark chasm of the lower tongue.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-4: You check the tension on the frayed guide-cables while the bronze clapper vibrates rhythmically against your frost-stiffened coat.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-5: A fog-warden named Bran checks your pack-straps with cold, competent hands before pointing toward the lower mist-line.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-6: You chop through a wall of blue drift-snow that has completely sealed the entrance to the old climber's shelter.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-7: The iron spikes on your boots ring sharply against a submerged boulder beneath the thin and brittle glacier crust.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-8: You hoist the heavy cradle higher onto your shoulders as the gradient steepens toward the final icy col.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-9: Answering the terrace millers' whistling wind-calls earns you a hidden path through the sheltered rock ribs of the cliff.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-10: A low tremor ripples through the glacier, setting the bronze clapper into a deep, sustained hum that numbs your teeth.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-11: You guide the stubborn mule across a trembling bridge constructed of braided wire and frozen larch timber.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-12: A patch of rotten firn collapses beneath your leading foot, leaving you dangling by your safety line over empty space.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-13: You trade a mouthful of melted snow with a weary rope-tender named Miri who guards the lower glacier winch.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-14: The wind drops suddenly, leaving an absolute and ringing silence over the vast expanse of white and jagged ice.
seeds.vh-4-2-3-15: You haul yourself over the final lip of the glacier tongue, leaving the freezing labyrinth of ladders behind.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-0: You stumble onto the frozen rocky moraine at the glacier's foot, where the air grows heavier and less brittle.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-1: A weathered signpost frozen into the terminal moraine points down toward the distant, fog-choked canopy of the orchard valleys.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-2: Biscuit shakes the rime from her grey ears while you unbuckle the heavy padded cradle from your exhausted shoulders.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-3: You look back up the towering white cascade of the glacier ladders, marveling that the bronze clapper made the descent intact.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-4: A lone fog-warden named Rix waits by the stone boundary marker to guide travelers down into the misty lower tiers.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-5: You massage feeling back into your frost-nipped fingers while the bronze clapper gives one last fading hum in the quiet air.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-6: The icy wind finally softens into a damp, apple-scented breeze blowing up from the mist-shrouded orchard valleys below.
seeds.vh-4-2-4-7: You step past the stone threshold of the glacier's reach, setting your feet firmly on the muddy path toward the fogbanks.
seeds.vh-4-2-5-0: You lead the mule down the winding stone track as the gray shapes of the upper orchard fences loom through the rising mist.
seeds.vh-4-2-5-1: A distant bell tolls dully from the fog-warden post below, marking the safe passage of another traveler off the high ice.
seeds.vh-4-2-5-2: The last frozen rungs of the mountain world vanish behind you as the wet canopy of the fogbank orchards closes in.
seeds.vh-4-2-5-3: You adjust the heavy cradle on your back and stride into the damp, silver twilight of the lower orchard terraces.
seeds.vh-d-4-2: You attempt to glissade down an unroped ice chute with the heavy clapper, losing your footing and tumbling endlessly into the deep blue crevasse maze.
